payload.accounts: Four independent total-$1000 paper accounts; flat sleeves, empty pending orders and confirmation streaks at inception.
payload.benchmark: QQQ buy-and-hold: costed first future-open purchase, ongoing marked holdings and distributions; no monitoring-date sale. Same-clock modeled cash control.
payload.cash_compounding: Once per unique native open/close/17NY event timestamp, including overnight/weekend elapsed time.
payload.change_policy: No refit, ETF/rule/weight change or future winner switch. A changed model requires a separate prospective dated experiment, never replacement of this record.
payload.confirmation: Seven consecutive native half-hour checks / three trading hours; next eligible observed bar-open fill. Preview daily features causally; finalize daily recursion once at17NY.
payload.corporate_actions: Native raw prices, split and distributions; same fee-free dividend-reinvestment proxy, no taxes or extra market impact.
payload.data_wait_policy: No collector or QA-packet producer configured. Missing/incomplete inputs block observations, never fabricate flat returns or automatically change inception.
payload.feature_history: Complete verified2015-01-02 through pre-inception daily seed; features only, never pre-start holdings/orders/streaks.
payload.historical_interpretation: 2024-01-01–2026-10-15 was retrospective portfolio-selection in-sample, excluded from forward record. October16–20 are not backdated forward days.
payload.monitoring: Weekdays18:15 America/New_York; consumes local sealed packets; no broker connection or automatic commits/pushes.
payload.observations: Completed-day modeled paper accounting; actual processing/capture times preserved. Late capture is delayed reconstruction, not contemporaneously logged execution.
payload.portfolio_transfers: None. Initial capital allocation only; sleeve shares drift freely after inception, with no ongoing one-third cap.
payload.primary_choice: Explicit human choice: Initial allocation, no rebalancing
payload.publication: Aggregate net daily portfolio/QQQ/cash returns and non-sensitive status only. Raw prices, per-sleeve positions, fills, private receipts and credentials remain private.
payload.revision_policy: Accepted seed/session and aggregate-return prefixes immutable; quarantine discrepancies and preserve attempts. No silent history repair.
payload.source_policy: Certified native raw30-minute regular-session inputs only; complete XNYS grid, actions and passing strict reconciliation receipts. No downloads/credentials or external-queue changes by tracker.

strategies.label: Mean reversion: Wilder RSI(14), enter ≤ 30, exit ≥ 50

payload.terminal_policy: No forced liquidation at monitoring cutoffs. Positions carry. Prospective termination requires separate authorization.
